test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Which sentence contains a word that is spelled incorrectly?

options.text: The actors had a final **rehearsel **before the big show.
The soldier jumped out of the plane using a **parachute**.
The students gathered **together** in the assembly hall.
She carefully placed the vase on the **shelf.**

solution:
The correct answer is **option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'rehearsel'.**

 
• **The correct spelling would be 'rehearsal'.**
 
• The word '**rehearsal**' is a **noun** which means 'a practice or trial performance of a play or other work for later public performance'. (पूर्वाभ्या
